policyNotes: LegacyFacet.setMinTimelockPeriod emitted successful zero-log receipts; canonical plan behavior verified at a one-day minimum, then the local-fork minimum was restored to seven days. The setter receipts were journaled and replayed idempotently.

Vesting creation used 1,000 base units per fresh beneficiary. Receipts emitted VestingScheduleCreated, direct/API schedule readbacks matched, and the founder balance decreased by the exact aggregate amount.
LegacyFacet.addBeneficiary and LegacyFacet.setBeneficiaryRelationship remain open because current deployed code omits their reviewed BeneficiaryUpdated events. No exception was counted.

The reviewed write invariant for LegacyFacet.setMinTimelockPeriod was corrected to match the deployed/source contract: VOICE_ADMIN_ROLE, behavioral legacy-plan readback because the global value has no getter, and no token balance effects.
